fields.description: Which outflow channel the uploaded statement came from. Each source has its own parser adapter; adding one is an adapter plus an option here.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: The uploaded statement file. THE FILE LIVES HERE AND ONLY HERE (owner ruling R3, 2026-08-06). Settled records link back to this batch and their row -- they must NEVER carry a copy of this file_url, because a Frappe File can be attached_to exactly one doc and deleting that doc cascades remove_all, leaving every other reference pointing at a 404.
fields.label: Source File

fields.description: The uploaded file's original name, kept for display because the stored File name is hashed.
fields.label: Original Filename

fields.description: Earliest transaction date in the file (min of the raw Added On). Derived at parse time, never entered.
fields.label: Period From

fields.description: Latest transaction date in the file (max of the raw Added On). Derived at parse time, never entered.
fields.label: Period To

fields.description: An earlier batch whose period overlaps this one. WARNING ONLY -- an overlap never blocks an upload (owner ruling). Precise per-row duplicate detection keys on Outflow Import Row.transfer_id, not on this range.
fields.label: Overlaps Batch

fields.description: Batch lifecycle. Draft = uploaded, not yet parsed into rows. In Review = rows staged, decisions outstanding. Partially Settled = some rows settled or skipped, some not. Completed = every row settled or skipped. DERIVED ONLY by services/outflow_import/status.py -- nothing else may write it. 'Completed with exceptions' was retired at the v3 reversal: closing a batch now records closed_at only and never changes what the status says, because the three tabs show outstanding work directly.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
In Review
Partially Settled
Completed

fields.description: Rows parsed from the file, including non-SUCCESS rows (which are staged and then auto-skipped, so the skip stays visible).
fields.label: Total Rows

fields.description: Rows that have left Pending -- the decision-progress counter surfaced on the import list.
fields.label: Reviewed Rows

fields.description: Rows that settled a record -- an Approved payment or expense marked Paid, or a fresh expense created at Paid. Under the v3 spine this covers all three ledgers, not expenses alone.
fields.label: Settled Rows

fields.description: Rows skipped -- duplicates, non-SUCCESS transfers, or a manual skip (which requires a reason).
fields.label: Skipped Rows

fields.description: Rows whose write failed and were rolled back to their own savepoint. The rest of the batch is unaffected.
fields.label: Error Rows

fields.description: Sum of the beneficiary Amount column across SUCCESS rows. EXCLUDES service charge and tax -- this is what reached beneficiaries, not what left the bank.
fields.label: Gross Amount

fields.description: Sum of Service Charge + Service Tax across SUCCESS rows. Real money that leaves the bank and belongs to no row, which is why the batch total never equals the sum of the rows.
fields.label: Charges Amount

fields.description: The single aggregated Bank Fees & Charges non-project expense booked for this batch's charges, if the user opted in. OPT-IN: absent means the charges were surfaced and deliberately not booked.
fields.label: Charges Expense

fields.description: Who uploaded the file (frappe.session.user). Data, not Link -- mirrors the house convention for actor fields (see BoQ Rate Suggestion Run.run_by).
fields.label: Uploaded By

fields.description: When the file was uploaded and parsed.
fields.label: Uploaded At

fields.description: When someone deliberately closed this batch while rows still needed a decision. THIS FIELD IS THE FLAG -- its presence is what makes the derived status 'Completed with exceptions' rather than 'In Review'. Closing does NOT freeze the batch: an abandoned row can still be settled later, and the status re-derives when it is. Cleared by reopening.
fields.label: Closed At

fields.description: Who closed the batch (frappe.session.user). Data, not Link, per the house convention for actor fields.
fields.label: Closed By

fields.description: Why the remaining rows were left undecided. Optional -- unlike a per-row manual skip, which always requires one, because closing abandons rows in bulk without claiming a decision about any individual one.
fields.label: Close Reason
